Hi, Speedrunners! 
Today we are proud to announce [b]"The Drunk Side of the Moon"[/b], the first DLC Expansion for SEUM. It brings a ton of new content to the original game including 3 new powerups, 33 new levels, and new speedrun mutators! 
https://youtu.be/6G7KptTt1dw
[h1]What's on the Drunk side of the Moon? [/h1]
[list]
    [*][h1]Roar[/h1]
(New Powerup!): Point and fly, super-fast way to fly through levels. It feels like guiding a Redeemer on steroids.
    [*][h1]Rocket[/h1]
(New Powerup!): Now you can rocket jump, and it’s fun. But we haven’t stopped there! You can actually jump on the rocket and ride it! Going too slow? No problem shoot the rocket with a fireball to give it an extra boost.

notes.title: SEUM: Speedrunners From Hell - officially announced!
notes.notes:
Today, we (Pine Studio and Headup Games) globally announced that SEUM will be coming to PC, Mac and Linux in late July. But not only that - we also created a new Trailer, you can watch it here: 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/457210

[img]http://www.headupgames.com/exchange/presse/2016/SEUM/SeumSubtitle.jpg[/img]

[b]SEUM: Speedrunners From Hell[/b] is about running through tricky stages that bristle with obstacles and traps. Think Super Meat Boy + Portal + Quake and you'll get a general idea - hardcore and fast and once started, you can't stop again. Hell, it is the first competitive heavy metal first-person platformer! You run, jump, fly and teleport through more than a hundred deadly arenas, each more devilish than the last. Play your best, and secure a top spot in the online leaderboards and find the beer cans hidden throughout in every level. Hell yeah - beer!  :-)

[img]http://www.headupgames.com/exchange/presse/2016/SEUM/SEUM_Screen02.jpg[/img]

And is there a story in SEUM? Yes, of course it is! It's all about Marty who had a really bad morning: Demons disrupted his late breakfast and ripped off his right arm; but even worse: they stole all his beer - the last batch of [i]limited edition Walrus Ale (tm)[/i]! Pissed as hell, he ripped off an arm of a fallen demon and attached it to himself. Well, not beautiful but quite handy, as it casts some nasty fireballs.

So his morning plans have changed: he's heading to hell to get back his beer - and deliver some payback..ASAP!
